text.offer: A strong warrior, are thee? The war against the avars has taken a toll on us. If you're willing to lend a hand, the people of Ko'catan will be thankful. Start with their warriors: slay twenty avars in the jungle.
text.progress: The war still continues. Report back to Cital ko'Manca when the task is done.
text.complete: Good work, warrior. Your efforts will be noted in the books.

steps.brief: Those warriors are just the fodder. We need to target their magical forces. Go kill fifteen avar shamans in the jungle.
A true warrior of blood! You are strong! The last thing we need to do is take out their command. Go and slay an avar chieftain in the jungle.
